title: Stock
description: Stock market data for a publicly traded company including current price, price changes, trading volume, market capitalization, daily price range, and exchange information. Used for stock trading platforms and financial dashboards.

id.description: Unique identifier for the stock record

symbol.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g., AAPL, GOOGL, MSFT)

name.description: Full company name of the stock issuer

exchange.description: Stock exchange where the stock is traded (e.g., NYSE, NASDAQ, LSE)

change.description: Price change amount from previous close (can be positive or negative)

change_percent.description: Price change percentage from previous close

volume.description: Number of shares traded during the current trading session

market_cap.description: Total market capitalization (price × total shares outstanding)

high.description: Highest price reached during the current trading session

low.description: Lowest price reached during the current trading session

open.description: Opening price at the start of the current trading session

previous_close.description: Closing price from the previous trading session

currency.description: ISO currency code for the stock price (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP)

timestamp.description: Timestamp when this stock data was recorded
